title: `util::relative_entropy` returns NaN for a vector with a zero probability
body: The function computes `p * log2(p / q)` for every entry. A zero `p` makes that term `0 * -inf`, which is NaN. Easel's `esl_vec_FRelEntropy` skips a zero `p`. `Profile::from_blosum_62_and_seq` kept its own inline copy of the sum, which `8149a3b` fixed for `*` queries. This issue fixes the helper and has `from_blosum_62_and_seq` call it.
